test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: The man walks with a grate deal of poise, in fact, very much like an elephant, but he also has the agelity of the panther.
The man walks with a great deal of poise, in fact, very much like an elephant, but he also has the agility of the panther.
The man walks with a great deal of poise, in fact, very much like an elephant, but he also has the agility of the panthur.
The man walks with a great deel of poise, in fact, very much like an ephalnt, but he also has the agility of the panther.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "grate" is a misspelling of **"great,"** which means of an extent, amount, or intensity considerably above the normal or average. (महान)

 
 
• **Example: **He did a great job on his presentation.
 
 
 
• "Agelity" is a misspelling of **"agility,"** which refers to the ability to move quickly and easily. (चुस्ती)
 
 
• **Example: **The gymnast's agility was impressive during the performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct words are **"great"** (महान) and **"agility"** (चुस्ती).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The man walks with a grate deal of poise, in fact, very much like an elephant, but he also has the agelity of the panther.

 
 
• **Grate** (झंझरी): A metal framework used for cooking over an open fire.

 
 
• **Example:** The cheese was grated over the pasta.
 
 
 
• **Agelity**: Incorrect spelling of "agility" (चुस्ती).
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The man walks with a great deal of poise, in fact, very much like an elephant, but he also has the agility of the panthur.
 
 
• **Panthur**: Incorrect spelling of "panther" (तेंदुआ).
 
 
• **Example:** The panther moved silently through the jungle.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The man walks with a great deel of poise, in fact, very much like an ephalnt, but he also has the agility of the panther.
 
 
• **Deel**: Incorrect spelling of "deal" (सौदा).
 
 
• **Example:** Let's make a deal.
 
 
 
• **Ephalnt**: Incorrect spelling of "elephant" (हाथी).
 
 
• **Example:** The elephant is the largest land animal.
 
 
 
 

36:T812,

The correct answer is** option 1**
